title: WiiM Hub
subtitle: A calm view of what your speakers are doing.
emptyHint: List devices in DEVICE_HOSTS, or scan the network.
hubDownHint: It keeps retrying on its own.
hubStale: Last state received {age}, and it keeps retrying on its own.

guides.title: Guided checks
guides.note: Checked in a fixed order, the cheapest question first.
guides.stopped: The flow stops at the first anomaly: that row is the last one.
guides.unsettled: The flow stopped on a check the player could not answer.

check.offline: The player does not answer: {failures} consecutive poll failure(s).
check.link: The radio link reads {rssi} dBm, {snr} dB SNR.
check.weakLink: The radio link is weak: {rssi} dBm, {snr} dB SNR.
check.volumeUnknown: The player did not report its volume.
check.sleepTimerArmed: A sleep timer will stop the player in {minutes} min.
check.transportUnknown: The player did not report its transport state.
check.stopped: The transport is stopped: nothing is playing.
check.externalSilent: The {input} input is selected and it is not playing: no signal reaches the player.
check.outputUnlisted: The active output ({hardware}) is not in the list the player reports.
check.outputsUnknown: The player did not report its outputs.
check.outputUnknown: The player did not report its active output.
check.groupCommandsMissing: The player does not report the group protocol version.
check.groupNone: This player is in no group.
check.groupMaster: This speaker drives a group of {count} member(s).
check.groupMember: This speaker follows a group of {count} member(s).
check.groupSavedOnly: A saved group exists but nothing runs on it.
check.groupNoMember: This player is a group member and the group lists no member.
check.counters: The network counters are not read yet.
check.wifiDrops: The Wi-Fi dropped {count} time(s), the last one {minutes} min ago.
check.crashCounters: {count} crash counter(s) are non zero: the firmware restarted.

services.hint: The top tier this model reaches, as the firmware publishes it. A dash means the casting app decides.
services.offline: The player is offline: its table is read when it answers.
services.failed: Could not read the streaming table.
services.none: This firmware does not publish its streaming table.

update.ready: A new version of the hub is ready.
update.hint: Reload to apply it. Your view and settings stay.

controls.unsupported: This player does not accept that command.

sound.title: Sound
sound.offHint: The curve is stored but not applied while the equalizer is off.
sound.roomFit: This player reports room correction. Adjusting it stays out of the hub until the setting is proven.
sound.unavailable: This player does not report an equalizer.
sound.offline: Device unreachable, its equalizer cannot be read.
sound.quality: Stream quality as reported by the player

device.title: Device settings
device.subtitle: Written to the speaker itself. The hub stores nothing.
device.name: Name
device.ledHint: The small light under the speaker.
device.buttonsHint: Play, volume and preset buttons on the device.
device.fadeHint: Smooth the start and the end of a track.
device.maxVolumeHint: The ceiling of the volume slider.

hosts.title: Devices
hosts.hint: Addresses the hub polls. A saved entry survives a restart; a discovered one comes back on the next scan.
hosts.empty: Nothing to poll yet: add an address, or run a discovery.

stream.title: Play a stream
stream.hint: The speaker fetches the address itself. http or https only.

findings.title: Findings
findings.pending: Network counters are read within the first minute.
findings.offline: The player does not answer: {failures} consecutive poll failure(s).
findings.weakLink: The radio link is weak: {rssi} dBm, {snr} dB SNR, {rate} Mb/s on {band} GHz.
findings.wifiDrops: The Wi-Fi dropped {count} time(s), the last one {minutes} min ago.
findings.crashCounters: {count} crash counter(s) are non zero: the firmware restarted.
findings.flashWear: The flash shows {bad} bad blocks of {total} ({ratio}).
findings.hardwareFault: A hardware probe reports a fault: {fields}.
findings.upnpActionsLost: {lost} UPnP action(s) were lost out of {total}.
findings.eventingDegraded: The push channel was contradicted by {misses} poll(s): the hub is polling at the fast rate.
findings.sleepTimer: A sleep timer will power the player off in {minutes} min.
